Description de l'emploi

  • EQUANS 

    •  

    Equans is a world leader in the energy and services sector, with annual revenues of nearly €19,2 billion* and almost 800,000 projects. 

     

    Equans has leading positions in Europe, which is the result of the history of energy construction in these countries, and strong presences in North and South America and in Oceania. 

    With nearly 90,000 highly skilled employees, Equans has a strong geographic footprint, anchored by historic local brands. Equans provides its customers with excellent technical expertise in the design, installation, maintenance and operation of multi-technical facilities. This know-how is based on key skills. First of all, in electrical and thermal engineering - two strong points that help accelerate the reduction of our clients' carbon footprint - but also in ventilation, refrigeration, mechanics and robotics, fire protection, energy renovation, digital solutions, IT, cyber security and telecommunications. 

     

    The combination of these expertise allows us to offer efficient and optimised solutions at all stages of the energy chain, from production, storage and transport to usage. 

     

    (*) Turnover 2024 consolidated 

     

     

    Cybersecurity Solutions Expert (Product Owner)

     

    Summary of the role:

     

    Cybersecurity is part of Equans Group Core values. Equans deployed global security solutions at group level in order to provide unified cybersecurity services.  

    As a Cybersecurity Solutions Expert (Product Owner), you will be responsible for maximizing the value of one or more of these global cybersecurity solutions, EDR and CSPM at the moment (MDE, Crowdstrike Falcon or WIZ). This position will allow you to develop in depth expertise of a complex cybersecurity solution as the leading expert and support role as well as getting direct exposure to the power user’s business use cases. You will be engaged on the mid-to-the-long-term product development roadmap and answer daily operations requests during on-duty weeks. 

    You provide cybersecurity-related technical development, integration, testing, implementation, operation, maintenance, monitoring and support of cybersecurity solutions to our internal cybersecurity teams.  

    Yous ensure adherence to specifications and conformance requirements, assures sound performance and resolve technical issues required in the cybersecurity-related solutions. 

     

    KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

     

    Accountable for:

    • Defining the solutions requirements and periodically challenging the vendors as the market evolves. 
    • Identifying use cases and prioritizing value creation opportunities in the product backlog. 
    • Evaluating new features and testing them on pilot scopes when necessary. 
    • Maintaining product architecture documentation and release plans. 

     

    Responsible for:

    • Detection and analysis of new needs as the cyber threat landscape evolves. 
    • Maintaining an engaged user community and gathering feedback in order to understand the current use cases and improvement opportunities. 

     

    Main tasks:

    • Develop, implement, maintain, upgrade, test cybersecurity products.  
    • Provide cybersecurity-related support to users (internal cybersecurity teams).
    • Integrate cybersecurity solutions and ensure their sound operation. 
    • Securely configure systems, services and products.  
    • Maintain and upgrade the security of systems, services and products.  
    • Implement cybersecurity procedures and controls. 
    • Monitor and assure the performance of the implemented cybersecurity controls.
    • Document and report on the security of systems, services and products.  
    • Work close with the IT/OT personnel on cybersecurity-related actions.  
    •  Implement, apply and manage patches to products to address technical vulnerabilities.
    • Maintaining the product backlog. 
    • Defining, prioritizing and validating features requirements through User Stories. 
    • Planning sprint/iteration goals for continuous product improvement. 
    • Working across teams to implement improvement stories and MVPs.  
    • Participating in user demos and retrospective. 

     

     

    PROFILE:

     

    Academic background & experience:

    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields. 
    • Minimum 4 years of experience in ICT in complex enterprise environments. 
    • Familiarity with both standard service management (ITIL) and Agile methodologies exposed to Wiz products ideally and CSPM solutions. 

     

    Behavioral capabilities: 

    • Autonomy: Be a problem solver. 
    • Builder: Ability to grow and document expertise on the product itself and to capitalize knowledge of the business needs through any user interaction. 
    • Value driven: Ability to identify and prioritize opportunities to extract value from product features and data beyond its initial scope. 
    • Team player: Ability and willingness to cooperate with other product owners and analysts inside or outside the team in order to combine offers, share expertise and identify even more value opportunities. 

     

    Skills:  

    • Understanding of the special responsibilities of high privilege access to cybersecurity information through global, powerful tools. 
    • Knowledge of security architecture principles and components, including cloud platforms, networking, devices management, server management, identity and access management, and more. 
    • Ability to deploy and test Proof Of Concepts and Minimum Viable Products out quickly in collaboration with other product owners. 
    • Practice of Agile product management methodologies. 

     

    Why Join Us? 

     

    • Global Reach: Influence Integration strategy across continents and business units. 
    • Technical Challenge: Work on complex identity scenarios in a hybrid, high-scale environment. 
    • Supportive Culture: Join a team that values innovation, transparency, and continuous learning.
